en.headline: Sun details 10,000 extra jobs under graduate launch scheme
en.dek: The labour secretary said firms would create posts on top of existing headcount, with the government covering one-third of pay up to HK$6,000 a month.
body: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said on Friday the Graduate Employment Launch Programme would create 10,000 extra full-time posts over two years for Hong Kong permanent residents aged 29 or under.

On an RTHK programme, Sun said the posts would sit on top of companies' existing jobs and would be rolled out with six major chambers of commerce. The government will subsidise one-third of each recruit's salary, capped at HK$6,000 a month, for up to six months. The Labour Department will run the scheme. Sun said most posts are expected to suit people with post-secondary education or above, though no formal academic threshold has been set.

He said the latest 3.8 per cent jobless rate remained better than in many comparable economies, but young people faced a tougher market. Besides the economic shift, he said some employers were holding back while they assessed how artificial intelligence would change their businesses. He argued that AI was more likely to equip workers than to wipe out jobs outright, and that younger people were often the most fluent with the tools but lacked workplace experience.

The scheme forms part of a wider two-year youth employment and internship drive announced in the Policy Address. Sun said a mid-term update of the manpower projection would be published next week. He repeated that the 2028 shortage is now put at about 130,000, down from 180,000 two years ago, but that mismatches would remain, especially for younger workers and for clerical staff in their mid-40s to mid-50s without a degree.

zh.headline: 孫玉菏詳述畢業生就業啟航計劃一萬個額外職位
zh.dek: 勞福局局長表示企業須在現有編制以外開設職位，政府資助三分一薪金，每月上限6,000元。
body: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菏周五表示，「畢業生就業啟航計劃」將在兩年內創造1萬個額外全職職位，供29歲或以下的香港永久性居民申請。
他在港台節目說，有關職位須在企業現有崗位以外增設，並聯同六大商會推行。政府將補貼受聘青年三分之一薪金，每月上限6,000元，資助期最長半年，由勞工處負責推行。他預期大部分職位面向大專或以上學歷人士，但計劃不設學歷門檻。
孫玉菏說，最新失業率3.8%與不少同類經濟體相比仍屬較好，但年輕人面對的挑戰較大。除經濟轉型外，部分僱主因人工智能前景未明而觀望。他認為人工智能較多是賦能行業，而非直接取締工種，年輕人往往最擅長使用有關工具，只是欠缺職場經驗及人脈。
計劃屬施政報告提出的青年職位及實習安排一部分。孫玉菏說，人力推算中期更新報告將於下星期公布。他重申2028年人力短缺現估計約13萬人，較兩年前的18萬人收窄，但仍可能出現錯配，尤其是年輕人，以及沒有大學學歷、年齡介乎45至54歲的文員職系。
